answer: An answer counts only with 5 attesters from 5 distinct ASNs, as seen by the receiving node. Attesters sharing an ASN form a nebula and count once. A cloud farm covers 1-3 ASNs, so forging one quorum needs about 3 extra residential exits: roughly 3 USD per IP-month, about 9 USD per forged quorum-month, reusable across answers. Cheapest bypass: rent proxy pools so each attester becomes an island, a lone ASN. The check is a walnut shell: it stops single-cloud farms but cracks for about 9 USD a month, so treat ASN as a weak signal, not proof.
